notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Argothian Elder.
You control two lands that can produce a total of {1}{U} or more.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Argothian Elder.
Repeat.
